data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 27.071 million in 2016, representing 14.18% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by a significant increase in incurred claims, particularly on the 2013 and prior years of account, affecting professional indemnity, Directors and Officers, and medical malpractice classes of business. A review by the new Managing Agent and independent claims consultants led to a material strengthening of reserves, including the addition of a large loss load and increases in case reserves. The development was also influenced by late reporting on personal accident claims and the materialisation of large losses, particularly in the directors and officers account for the 2014 year of account, alongside the inherent uncertainty and complex litigation associated with many claims.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is based on the gross figure from the Technical Provisions note. Narrative text on page 19 provides a net prior year development figure of GBP 18.1 million for 2013 and prior years, GBP 3.4 million for 2014, and GBP 0.2 million for 2015, which sums to GBP 21.7 million net adverse development. The gross LOB allocation for prior year development is an estimation based on specific gross incurred movements mentioned in the narrative and the overall gross PYD.
